title: Posed · adj
subtitle: 「經安排的／擺拍的／被擺好位置的」，究竟是哪一種 posed？
description: 「經安排的／擺拍的／被擺好位置的」，究竟是哪一種 posed？

words.note: 最直接的近義詞之一。當 posed 指人物、物件或場景被有意安排成某個位置或構圖時很自然。
words.example: The photographer took an arranged group portrait after the ceremony.
words.exampleZh: 典禮後，攝影師拍了一張經安排的團體照。

exercises.original: The family took a posed photograph in front of the house.
exercises.zh: 這家人在屋前拍了一張經安排的照片。
exercises.upgrade: arranged · 經安排的；擺設好的

options.explanation: candid = candid 表示自然抓拍，和 posed 相反。
spontaneous = 表示沒有安排，不合。
arranged = 家庭成員被安排好位置再拍照，arranged 是直接替換。
still = 只表示靜止，不代表照片經過擺位。
photographed = 只表示被拍攝，沒有安排含義。
decorated = 不表示人物姿勢或位置安排。

exercises.original: The objects in the display were posed carefully for the catalogue image.
exercises.zh: 展示中的物件為目錄照片被仔細擺好。
exercises.upgrade: arranged · 經安排的；擺設好的

options.explanation: natural = 和仔細擺放的意思相反。
still = 物件本來就可能不動，但重點是排列方式。
directed = 物件不能像人一樣接受指示。
arranged = catalogue image 中物件被有意配置，最自然用 arranged。
photographed = 沒有表達事前配置。
spontaneous = 不合有意安排。

exercises.original: The portrait showed the children in a posed grouping around their grandparents.
exercises.zh: 這幅肖像把孩子們安排在祖父母周圍。
exercises.upgrade: arranged · 經安排的；擺設好的

options.explanation: candid = grouping 明顯是安排過的，不是抓拍。
natural = 未必自然形成。
still = 不表示 grouping 的配置。
decorated = 不合人物位置。
arranged = grouping around their grandparents 強調人物配置，因此 arranged 很合適。
photographed = 只是拍攝行為。

words.note: 當 posed 指照片、場景或動作不是自然發生，而是為拍攝、展示或效果而刻意安排時最常用。
words.example: The image looked staged rather than spontaneous.
words.exampleZh: 這張照片看起來像擺拍，而不是自然抓拍。

exercises.original: The supposedly casual photo was actually posed.
exercises.zh: 那張看似隨意的照片其實是擺拍的。
exercises.upgrade: staged · 擺拍的；刻意安排的

options.explanation: candid = 和 actually posed 的事實相反。
spontaneous = 同樣表示自然發生。
natural = 不合刻意安排。
staged = supposedly casual 與 actually 的對比很典型地支持 staged。
still = 靜止和擺拍不是同一回事。
photographed = 所有照片都被拍攝，這不能區分是否擺拍。

exercises.original: The scene looked too perfect to be natural and seemed posed for social media.
exercises.zh: 這個場景完美得不像自然形成，像是為社交媒體擺拍。
exercises.upgrade: staged · 擺拍的；刻意安排的

options.explanation: decorated = 可能有裝飾，但重點是整個場景被安排。
still = 不合。
directed = 場景本身不是接受指示。
candid = 和 too perfect to be natural 相反。
staged = too perfect to be natural 明確暗示擺拍，staged 最自然。
spontaneous = 同樣不合。

exercises.original: Several viewers suspected that the emotional reunion had been posed for the cameras.
exercises.zh: 有些觀眾懷疑那場感人的重聚是為鏡頭而安排的。
exercises.upgrade: staged · 擺拍的；刻意安排的

options.explanation: natural = 如果是自然發生就不會是 staged。
candid = 不合被安排的重聚。
still = 不合。
photographed = 被拍攝不等於整件事被安排。
decorated = 完全不合事件。
staged = 事件為鏡頭而事先安排，staged 是標準用詞。

words.meaning: 被擺放在某位置的；定位好的
words.note: 當 posed 的重點是人物或物件被放在特定位置、方向或角度時可用；比 staged 更強調位置本身。
words.example: The model was carefully positioned beside the window.
words.exampleZh: 模特兒被仔細安排在窗邊的位置。

exercises.original: The model was posed beside the doorway to catch the light.
exercises.zh: 模特兒被安排在門口旁，以捕捉光線。
exercises.upgrade: positioned · 被擺放在某位置的；定位好的

options.explanation: candid = 這是刻意擺位，不是自然抓拍。
spontaneous = 不合。
still = 她可能站着不動，但重點是特定位置。
decorated = 不形容人物位置。
positioned = beside the doorway 明確是位置安排，最適合 positioned。
photographed = 不表示她被放在哪裡。

exercises.original: The vase was posed slightly to the left of the frame.
exercises.zh: 花瓶被放在畫面稍微偏左的位置。
exercises.upgrade: positioned · 被擺放在某位置的；定位好的

options.explanation: directed = 花瓶不能接受導演指示。
natural = 不表示具體位置。
still = 不代表 left of the frame。
photographed = 不表示擺放位置。
decorated = 不合。
positioned = 重點是畫面中的具體位置，positioned 最精確。

exercises.original: For the portrait, the couple were posed so that both faces caught the window light.
exercises.zh: 拍肖像時，這對伴侶被安排好位置，讓兩張臉都能接到窗光。
exercises.upgrade: positioned · 被擺放在某位置的；定位好的

options.explanation: positioned = 為了採光而調整人物的位置，positioned 很自然。
candid = 明顯不是抓拍。
spontaneous = 不合。
still = 不表示位置目的。
decorated = 不合人物。
photographed = 不能表達如何擺位。

words.meaning: 事先安排好的；佈置好的
words.note: 較口語。當 posed 指場景、照片或情況事先被安排好，以便拍攝或呈現某種效果時可用。
words.example: The scene was clearly set up for the photo.
words.exampleZh: 這個場景顯然是為拍照而事先安排好的。

exercises.original: The dinner-table scene was posed for the advertisement.
exercises.zh: 餐桌場景是為廣告而事先安排的。
exercises.upgrade: set up · 事先安排好的；佈置好的

options.explanation: candid = 廣告場景通常經安排，不是自然抓拍。
spontaneous = 和 set up 相反。
still = 不合場景安排。
photographed = 只表示拍攝。
directed = 可以有人指導，但不能完整表示整個場景已佈置好。
set up = 整個場景為廣告目的事先佈置，口語最自然用 set up。

exercises.original: The photo of the 'surprise' meeting was clearly posed.
exercises.zh: 那張『驚喜』見面的照片顯然是事先安排好的。
exercises.upgrade: set up · 事先安排好的；佈置好的

options.explanation: set up = 看似意外、實際事先安排的情況很常說 set up。
natural = 和 quotation marks around surprise 的暗示相反。
candid = 不合。
spontaneous = 不合。
decorated = 不是裝飾問題。
still = 不合。

exercises.original: The display was posed before the photographer arrived.
exercises.zh: 攝影師到達前，展示場景已事先佈置好。
exercises.upgrade: set up · 事先安排好的；佈置好的

options.explanation: photographed = 攝影師尚未到，顯然不是已拍攝。
set up = before the photographer arrived 強調事前安排，set up 很自然。
candid = 不合展示場景。
still = 不表示佈置。
natural = 不表示事先準備。
directed = display 不是被指導。

words.note: 透明、精確的描述性替換。當 posed 表示人物、物件或整個畫面不是自然形成，而是有意擺放時很合適。
words.example: The chairs and flowers were deliberately arranged for the photograph.
words.exampleZh: 椅子和花朵都是為了拍照而刻意擺放的。

exercises.original: The flowers and books looked posed rather than casually placed.
exercises.zh: 花和書看起來是刻意擺放，而不是隨意放置。
exercises.upgrade: deliberately arranged · 刻意安排的

options.explanation: deliberately arranged = rather than casually placed 直接支持『刻意安排』。
spontaneous = 和 deliberately arranged 相反。
natural = rather than casually placed 已排除自然隨意感。
still = 物件靜止不代表刻意排列。
photographed = 不是拍攝與否。
decorated = 可能被裝飾，但重點是位置安排。

exercises.original: The people in the image appeared posed, with equal spacing between them.
exercises.zh: 照片中的人看起來經過刻意安排，彼此間距相同。
exercises.upgrade: deliberately arranged · 刻意安排的

options.explanation: candid = 等距站位明顯不是自然抓拍。
deliberately arranged = equal spacing 是有意安排構圖的明確線索。
spontaneous = 不合。
still = 即使不動，也不能解釋 equal spacing。
directed = 可能被指導，但結果本身是 deliberately arranged。
photographed = 太一般。

exercises.original: The fruit was posed to create a balanced composition.
exercises.zh: 水果被刻意擺放，以形成平衡構圖。
exercises.upgrade: deliberately arranged · 刻意安排的

options.explanation: natural = 不合 create a balanced composition 的有意目的。
still = 不表示構圖設計。
deliberately arranged = to create a balanced composition 清楚說明是有意安排。
decorated = 水果不是被加裝飾，而是被排列。
photographed = 不能表達排列目的。
candid = 不適用靜物排列。

words.meaning: 構圖安排好的；精心配置的
words.note: 當 posed 指畫面中的人物或元素被仔細安排以形成特定視覺構圖時可用，常見於攝影和視覺藝術語境。
words.example: The portrait was carefully composed to emphasize symmetry.
words.exampleZh: 這幅肖像經過精心構圖，以突出對稱感。

exercises.original: The portrait was carefully posed to create a strong diagonal line.
exercises.zh: 這幅肖像經仔細構圖，以形成強烈的對角線。
exercises.upgrade: composed · 構圖安排好的；精心配置的

options.explanation: still = 不表示視覺構圖。
composed = 強調整體視覺構圖時，composed 最精確。
candid = 精心構圖與 candid 相反。
photographed = 拍攝只是結果，不是構圖。
natural = 不表示對角線設計。
decorated = 不合 portrait composition。

exercises.original: The group was posed symmetrically around the central figure.
exercises.zh: 這群人以中央人物為中心，對稱地安排構圖。
exercises.upgrade: composed · 構圖安排好的；精心配置的

options.explanation: spontaneous = 對稱安排不是自然形成。
candid = 不合。
composed = 以 symmetry 為核心的視覺安排可用 composed。
still = 不表示 symmetry。
photographed = 不表示排列方式。
decorated = 不合人物構圖。

exercises.original: Every element in the image felt posed with great care.
exercises.zh: 畫面中的每個元素都像經過非常仔細的構圖安排。
exercises.upgrade: composed · 構圖安排好的；精心配置的

options.explanation: natural = 語意相反。
still = 只表示靜止。
directed = 不能自然形容每個 image element。
composed = 整張畫面的元素經審慎配置，carefully composed 很自然。
photographed = 不表示構圖品質。
candid = 不適用精心安排的畫面。

words.meaning: 刻意造作的；不自然安排的
words.note: 帶負面評價。當 posed 不只表示安排過，而且看起來太刻意、缺乏自然感時可用；不能一般地取代所有 posed。
words.example: The smiles looked contrived and unnatural.
words.exampleZh: 那些笑容看起來很造作、不自然。

exercises.original: The smiles in the advertisement looked posed and unnatural.
exercises.zh: 廣告中的笑容看起來很造作、不自然。
exercises.upgrade: contrived · 刻意造作的；不自然安排的

options.explanation: candid = candid 通常反而自然。
spontaneous = 和 unnatural 的刻意感相反。
contrived = unnatural 直接帶出過度刻意、造作的負面感，因此 contrived 最貼切。
still = 笑容是否靜止不是問題。
photographed = 只是被拍攝。
decorated = 不形容笑容。

exercises.original: The conversation in the promotional video felt posed rather than genuine.
exercises.zh: 宣傳影片中的對話感覺很造作，而不是真實自然。
exercises.upgrade: contrived · 刻意造作的；不自然安排的

options.explanation: natural = 和 rather than genuine 相反。
candid = 不是未經安排的自然對話。
still = 不合 conversation。
contrived = rather than genuine 明確表示造作感，contrived 是最自然的評價詞。
directed = 對話可能被導演指導，但 contrived 更精確表達不自然結果。
photographed = 不合 video conversation 的評價。

exercises.original: The family scene looked too posed to feel believable.
exercises.zh: 這個家庭場景太過擺拍，令人覺得不可信。
exercises.upgrade: contrived · 刻意造作的；不自然安排的

options.explanation: spontaneous = 和 too posed 相反。
candid = 不合。
natural = 與 not believable 的人工感不符。
still = 不表示可信度。
contrived = too ... to feel believable 表示人工安排感過強，最適合 contrived。
photographed = 不表示場景造作。

falseSynonyms.zh: 自然發生，和 posed 相反 spontaneous 表示沒有預先安排、自然發生；posed 則通常表示有意擺位或安排。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Spontaneous means unplanned; posed means deliberately arranged.

falseSynonyms.zh: 抓拍不等於 posed candid 照片通常在人物沒有刻意擺姿勢時拍攝，和 posed portrait 形成直接對比。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A candid photo captures a natural moment; a posed photo is arranged.

falseSynonyms.zh: 自然不等於 posed natural 表示看起來不做作或沒有刻意安排；posed 可能完全相反。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Natural suggests an unforced appearance; posed suggests deliberate arrangement.

falseSynonyms.zh: 靜止不等於 posed still 只表示沒有移動；一個人可以靜止但並沒有刻意擺姿勢。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Still means not moving; posed means deliberately positioned.

falseSynonyms.zh: 被拍攝不等於 posed photographed 只表示被拍下；照片可以是 candid，也可以是 posed。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Photographed means captured in a photo; posed describes how the subject was arranged.

falseSynonyms.zh: 裝飾好不等於 posed decorated 指加上裝飾；posed 指人物或物件的位置、姿勢或場景安排。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Decorated concerns ornament; posed concerns arrangement or positioning.

falseSynonyms.zh: 被指導不等於 posed directed 表示有人給指示；它可能導致 posed 結果，但不等於人物已經處於某個擺好姿勢的狀態。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Directed refers to receiving instructions; posed refers to the arranged result.

falseSynonyms.zh: 動詞與形容詞／分詞用法不同 pose 可作動詞，表示擺姿勢；posed 可作過去式、過去分詞或形容詞，描述已擺好的狀態。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON They posed for the camera. It was a posed photograph.
